classes.name: Gladiator
classes.subtitle: Heavy weapon fighter
classes.summary: Broad melee pressure, durable positioning and flexible weapon choices.
classes.tip: Keep enemies positioned so your group can fight safely.

classes.name: Templar
classes.subtitle: Shield-bearing protector
classes.summary: A defensive frontline for keeping dangerous enemies occupied and protecting the party.
classes.tip: Bring damage dealers and reliable healing for longer encounters.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.subtitle: Close-range ambusher
classes.summary: Fast melee attacks, stealth and rune combinations reward careful target choice.
classes.tip: Plan your approach and escape before committing.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.subtitle: Bow-wielding hunter
classes.summary: Ranged physical attacks, traps and control help keep a safe distance.
classes.tip: Leave room to move and watch enemies that close the gap.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.subtitle: Master of destructive magic
classes.summary: Strong spells and crowd control reward good spacing and uninterrupted casting.
classes.tip: Protect your casting time and manage your mana.

classes.name: Spiritmaster
classes.subtitle: Spirit summoner
classes.summary: Summoned spirits, persistent damage and disruptive magic support a measured approach.
classes.tip: Account for your spirit’s position as well as your own.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.subtitle: Restorer and protector
classes.summary: Healing, cleansing and resurrection give a party a dependable recovery core.
classes.tip: Balance immediate recovery with mana and cooldown management.

classes.name: Chanter
classes.subtitle: Battlefield inspirer
classes.summary: Mantras, supportive skills, recovery and staff combat complement a group.
classes.tip: Coordinate recovery with your main healer.

classes.name: Aethertech
classes.subtitle: Aether-powered vanguard
classes.summary: A key-driven mechanical fighter that combines frontline presence with magical attacks.
classes.tip: Manage your resources and pick suitable defensive tools.

classes.name: Gunner
classes.subtitle: Aether firearm specialist
classes.summary: Pistols and aethercannons offer different rhythms of ranged magical pressure.
classes.tip: Choose range and weapon timing around the encounter.

classes.name: Songweaver
classes.subtitle: Melodic spellcaster
classes.summary: Music combines ranged magic with recovery, control and party support.
classes.tip: Balance offensive casting with the party’s recovery needs.

commands.description: List your offline account characters and active companions.
Recruit an eligible offline character from your own account. Replace <name> with the character name.
Save and dismiss your controlled companions.
Revive and summon eligible companions while alive and out of combat. Normal conditions still apply.
Interrupt companion activity and bring the party back to you. Regroup out of combat or use Attack to resume.
Hold the companions in position.
Switch your companions to the guard order.
Prevent companion attacks.
Attack your selected eligible hostile target. Normal combat rules apply.
Have a tank companion pull your selected monster back to the waiting party.
Mark your selected monster as the party’s focus target.
Reserve your selected monster for supported crowd control. Companions avoid breaking it with damage.
Clear the active target mark.
Set a companion role. Replace the placeholders with one name and one role.
Turn off optional area attacks for the controlled party.
Allow companions to use their own recovery consumables.
Allow eligible nearby corpse looting. Ownership, combat priorities and inventory space still matter.
Allow compatible inventory upgrades to be equipped automatically.
Inspect a companion’s active quest progress.
Allow supported nearby quest acceptance and turn-in.
Enable eligible grouped quest-completion sharing.
Arrange following companions around you in a circle. Other choices: box, line and spread.
Set follow spacing to four metres. Supported values range from 2 to 12 metres; attack spacing remains separate.
